name: OTP / Vishing / Banking Impersonation Fraud
ncrpCategory: Financial Fraud -> OTP / Vishing / Banking Impersonation
summary: Fraudsters call posing as bank managers, credit card representatives, or KYC verification officers, manipulating victims into sharing OTPs, CVVs, or card credentials.
rules: No bank, payment app, or government official will EVER ask for your OTP, CVV, or passwords over the phone.
Never share OTPs received for credit card reward redemption, KYC renewal, or account unblocking.
initialActionChecklist: Immediately dial 1930 (National Cyber Crime Helpline) with transaction reference and suspect caller details.
Call your bank customer care immediately to block/hotlist compromised debit/credit cards and freeze Netbanking access.
Immediately change your Netbanking passwords and UPI PIN from a clean, secure device.
Preserve call logs showing the suspect caller's phone number, call time, and duration.
Report the fraudulent phone number on the DoT Chakshu facility (sancharsaathi.gov.in).
evidenceRequired: Call log screenshot showing caller phone number, call time, and duration
Bank SMS showing transaction debit and the OTP request message
Bank account / credit card statement showing unauthorized transactions
Audio recording of the call (if available)
source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Safe Digital Banking Advisory & MHA I4C
